picture.label: Picture of the chosen colourway
picture.none: No picture of this colourway or style yet.
picture.fromStyle: The style's main picture (none of this colourway yet)

price.title: Price and margin
price.noPrice: Prices and margins are not shown to your role.
price.manualKept: The manual change of the price stays the same amount.
price.notHeld: The saved price does not hold the saved options: save them again to price the line with them.

held.NO_START: The line was priced by hand, without a waterfall: give it a start (from the list or the cost) in the price waterfall above, then the options join it. Their surcharges are kept on the line meanwhile.
held.NOT_SIZE_GRID: A made-to-measure unit is priced on its own: the options' surcharges are kept on the line, its price does not move by itself.

order.accepted: The order keeps the price the customer accepted.
order.more: These options add {amount} a piece more than accepted.
order.less: These options add {amount} a piece less than accepted.
order.amend: To charge the difference, amend the order instead: the customer accepts the new price.

groups.textMissing: Type the text this option takes.
groups.colourOrLeather: A choice takes a library colour or a leather article, not both.

check.outside: An option takes the garment outside its certificate.

artwork.title: Customer's artwork
artwork.empty: No artwork on this line yet.
artwork.held: Artwork is added while you may change this line.

problem.type: Artwork is a PDF or a picture (JPEG, PNG, WebP).
problem.size: A file is at most 25 MB.
problem.failed: The file could not be sent: try again.
problem.share: The portal sharing did not change: try again.

portal.shown: The artwork is shown in the customer's portal.
portal.hidden: The artwork is no longer shown in the portal.

save.doneRepriced: Options saved; the line is priced again.

held.blocked: This combination is not allowed: change it first.
held.checking: Wait for the combination to be checked.
held.keepPrice: Choose first: keep the accepted price, or amend the order.
held.offline: Offline: changes wait until the connection is back.

problem.read: The options could not be read.
problem.check: The combination could not be checked: try again.
problem.write: The options could not be saved.
problem.stale: Someone changed this line in the meantime: it was read again.
problem.forbidden: You may not change these options.

bench.title: Test a combination
bench.hint: A test only: choose a style and its options to see the rules, the surcharges and what changes in the making. Nothing is saved.
bench.stylePlaceholder: Search a style by code or name
bench.pick: Choose a style to test its options.
